Commentary.Commentary: For now, India go on top of the table in the Super Six. They will hope they reach the semi-finals. Do keep checking the points table and do keep checking the schedule page. For now, it is goodbye and cheers.

Shafali Verma, the skipper of India Women Under-19 says they didn't sleep well after the loss against Australia but today they executed the plan. Applauds the performance of Parshavi Chopra. Tells that the players are backing each other.
Parshavi Chopra wins the Player of the Match. She shays she enjoyed to play in this pitch as there was turn on offer. Says she enjoyed the wicket she got of Vishmi Gunaratne.
...Presentation coming up...

Shafali Verma came out and played as she always does and gave a blistering chance. Sri Lanka had a hope as they got Ghosh quickly as well but Shweta Sehrawat and Soumya Tiwari played out with easy to win the game. Just too easy for India. Sri Lanka were beaten all over in this game.

A comfortable chase in the end. A good recovery from India after losing to Australia and they put on a strong performance. It was the bowlers who did the job but most importantly it was an important toss to win for India. Their spinners trapped Sri Lanka in the web and the Lankans were just not able to get out of it. Wickets kept on tumbling. Only two players scored a double digit score but to be honset, it was just too low for Sri Lanka Women Under-19 to have a chance.
That is it! Around off, shorter and it is tucked to mid-wicket for one. India Women Under-19 win by 7 wickets.
FOUR! Just one needed! Flatter and on off. Tiwari pulls it to deep square leg in free space for four.

OUT! TAKEN! Something to cheer for Sri Lanka! Fuller and outside off. Shweta Sehrawat tries to finish it quickly as she looks to loft over cover but toe ends her shot and Vishmi Gunaratne there tracks back and takes over her head. She tumbles and does well to hold on.
Commentary.Howout: c Vishmi Gunaratne b Dewmi Vihanga

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Tiwari lofts it over the bowler and long off cuts it out for just a single.
Way outside off, dragged to long on for a single.
Flatter and on off. Tiwari plays it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and outside off, spins away. Tiwari looks to drive but misses. The keeper had a stumping chance but she fails to collect cleanly. Need to take those chances.
On middle, flicked past square leg for two runs.
FOUR! Outside off, this is driven hard through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! India dealing in boundaries! On off, pulled to deep square leg for four.
Again a direct hit was needed! Full and on off. Tiwari chips it to mid on. This time it was the batters who were sloppy.
A direct hit would have helped! On middle, this is hit to mid on for a quick single. A throw from the fielder but was a bit sloppy.
A single as this is hit to long off.
Too full and on off. Shweta Sehrawat heaves it to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! 14 off the over! On the pads. Tiwari whacks it to square leg where the fielder fails to stop it cleanly and it goes behind her for a boundary.
FOUR! Straight down! A loopy ball on off. Tiwari lofts it over the bowler and it runs past mid off for four more.
Full and on off. Shweta Sehrawat sweeps it hard to deep mid-wicket for one.
Around off, nudged to mid-wicket for one.
Drops it short and outside off, Tiwari punches it to cover.
FOUR! Threaded! Fuller and on off. Tiwari whips it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A maiden over! Fuller ball, outside off, pushed to point.
Fuller and outside off. This is driven to mid off.
Outside off. Shweta Sehrawat steps across and keeps it out.
Fuller and around off, driven nicely but finds mid off.
Outside off, punched to point.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover.
FOUR! Eventful over! 12 runs and two big wickets. Very full, outside off. Soumya Tiwari drives it past cover for four.
India living dangerously! On off, Soumya Tiwari chips it over the bowler.

OUT! That is another big wicket for Sri Lanka! There are putting in a fight! Tossed up, outside off, spins away. Ghosh tries to work on the leg side but gets an outside edge to Vihara Sewwandi who dives low and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Vihara Sewwandi b Dewmi Vihanga

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! through the gap! Very full, outside off. Ghosh throws his bat and hits it past point for four.

OUT! LBW! Big wicket for Sri Lanka! Tossed up on middle. Verma steps across to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. That was looking plumb. Sri Lanka Women Under-19 will be boosted with this wicket.
FOUR! Verma is in a hurry! Tossed up, outside off. Verma slog-sweeps it wide of deep mid-wicket for four.
Flatter and on off. Verma punches it to the right of mid on for one.
On off, kept out.
Outside off, pushed to cover.
This is angled down, on the pads Verman steps across to sweep but misses.
Shorter and on middle. Verma pulls it uppishly to deep mid-wicket where the fielder collects on a bounce.
SIX! BANG! FIrst of the match! A full toss,s dipping one but Verma stays back to tonk over long off for a six.
Vidushika Perera to bowl from the other side.
Fuller, outside off. Sehrawat steers it to short third man.
Fuller ball, outside off, Verma sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Misfield! Full and outside off, Sehrawat pushes it to point for a single.
Outside off, guided straight to point.
Very full and on off, played to the right of the bowler.
This is full and on middle. Verma works it to long on for one. India Women Under-19 are underway.
